title: The Walls That Held 1,000 Years
sentences: These walls kept out almost every army for a thousand years.
They were built in the early 400s, under Emperor Theodosius the Second.
Attackers faced a wide moat, an outer wall, then an inner wall about twelve meters high, with ninety-six towers.
Arabs, Avars, Bulgars and the Rus all failed to take the city.
Even the crusaders who took it in 1204 broke in mainly from the harbor, not through these land walls.
In 1453, Ottoman cannon battered them for weeks.
